nodes.name: AI-Driven Salary Negotiation Workflow

overview.overview:
SNAP (Salary Negotiation Automation Platform) is an AI-driven web-based solution that 
automates salary document analysis and negotiation workflows.

detailedDescription.detailedDescription:
SNAP (Salary Negotiation Automation Platform) is an AI-driven web-based solution that 
automates salary document analysis and negotiation workflows.
Earlier, HR and operations teams manually reviewed payslips, offer letters, experience letters, 
and hike letters.
They extracted and grouped salary components and performed complex calculations using 
company-specific rules.
This led to high effort, errors, and slow turnaround times.
SNAP transforms this into an intelligent, automated process delivering accurate salary insights 
and faster decisions.

challengekeyPoints: Unstructured & Inconsistent Documents -- Salary documents arrived as PDFs, Word files, and scanned images with varying quality.
High Human Effort & Dependency -- Each document required line-by-line review, increasing risk of errors.
Fragmented Data Management -- Salary data was maintained in spreadsheets and folders with no central repository.
Component Comparison Complexity -- Repetitive salary components across documents were difficult to identify and group.
Time-Consuming Calculations -- Manual computation of monthly CTC, yearly CTC, fixed vs variable pay, and deductions.

solutionContent.solutionContent: SNAP introduced an AI-driven document intelligence and analytics platform

solutionKeyPoints: Automated ingestion and reading of salary documents.
Intelligent classification of document types.
Accurate extraction and grouping of salary components.
Comparative analysis across multiple documents.
Automated salary calculations using company rules.
Centralized salary insights for decision-making.
missionKeyPoints: To build an AI-powered platform that automates salary document analysis and negotiation  workflows.
To replace manual document review and calculations with intelligent automation.
To ensure accurate extraction, grouping, and comparison of salary components.
To enable faster, consistent, and data-driven salary negotiation decisions.
goalKeyPoints: To automate ingestion and reading of salary documents across formats.
To centralize and structure salary data for each candidate.
To standardize salary calculations using company-defined rules.
To reduce turnaround time and operational dependency on manual effort.
keyOutcomes: Significant reduction in manual document review effort.
Faster salary negotiation turnaround time.
Improved accuracy in salary component extraction and calculations.
Consistent application of company salary rules.
Scalable handling of high candidate volumes.

collaboration.collaboration:
The platform was developed with close involvement from HR teams, recruitment operations, and 
business stakeholders. Continuous feedback helped refine extraction logic, calculation rules, 
and usability to align with real hiring scenarios.

conclusion.conclusion:
SNAP successfully transformed salary negotiation from a manual, error-prone process into a 
centralized, AI-powered workflow. By automating document intelligence, salary component 
analysis, and calculations, the platform enables HR teams to make faster, accurate, and 
consistent salary decisions while reducing operational effort and risk.

nodes.name: ALFA – Agentic AI Conversational Platform for Customer–Agent Training

overview.overview: An AI-driven business analytics chatbot platform that makes enterprise data accessible and actionable through natural language, voice commands, and document-based insights.

detailedDescription.detailedDescription:
PFA–ALFA is an AI-driven roleplay training platform built for the BPO and customer support 
industry.
Earlier, trainees relied on manual classroom training and human roleplay to learn customer 
handling.
This led to low confidence, inconsistent responses, and unnecessary call escalations.
PFA–ALFA provides a safe, scalable, and intelligent environment to practice real customer 
interactions before going live.

challengekeyPoints: High Risk with Real Customers -- Allowing freshers to interact with live customers impacts brand credibility.
Limited Exposure to Real Scenarios -- Not all customer behaviors and rare edge cases can be simulated manually.
High Human Effort & Cost -- Trainers must continuously roleplay and monitor trainees.
Scenario Creation Complexity -- Creating and maintaining realistic scenarios is time-consuming.
Lack of Safe Practice Environment -- No platform for trainees to fail, learn, and retry without consequences.

solutionContent.solutionContent: PFA–ALFA introduced an AI-driven, human-like roleplay training platform

solutionKeyPoints: AI-powered roleplay customers that behave like real humans.
User-defined scenarios and customer personalities.
Context-aware, stateful conversations.
Unlimited practice without escalation risk.
Ability to train multiple trainees simultaneously.
missionKeyPoints: To build an AI-powered roleplay training platform that simulates real customer  interactions.
To provide a risk-free environment for trainees to practice and improve communication  skills.
To reduce dependency on manual trainers and roleplay sessions.
To improve trainee confidence, consistency, and readiness for live customer calls.
goalKeyPoints: To simulate multiple customer personalities and real-world scenarios.
To enable unlimited, repeatable practice for trainees.
To ensure consistent and standardized training experiences.
To scale training across large batches without proportional increase in cost or effort.
keyOutcomes: Reduced dependency on human trainers for roleplay.
Improved trainee confidence and communication quality.
Faster readiness of freshers for live customer handling.
Consistent and standardized training experiences.​
Scalable training across large batches.

collaboration.collaboration:
The platform was developed in close collaboration with training teams, quality analysts, and 
operations managers. Continuous feedback helped refine scenario realism, customer behavior 
patterns, and conversation flows to match real contact-center environments.

conclusion.conclusion:
PFA–ALFA successfully transformed traditional roleplay-based training into a centralized, AI-
powered digital platform. By simulating realistic customer interactions in a safe environment, 
the solution improves trainee preparedness, reduces training cost and effort, and helps 
organizations deliver better customer experiences.

nodes.name: Pentafox Enhances Passenger Communication by Integrating Booking Contact Data with DCS Through the Guest Bridge Platform

overview.overview:
See how Pentafox streamlined post-booking meal selection
to improve convenience and ancillary revenue.

detailedDescription.detailedDescription:
Departure Control Systems (DCS) play a critical role in managing flight operations and passenger movement. However, the core DCS does not store or expose passenger contact details, such as mobile numbers, directly from booking data. This limitation created communication gaps and operational challenges, especially when teams needed to contact passengers close to departure time.
The Guest Bridge Application was introduced as a supporting layer alongside the existing DCS. It retrieves passenger contact and booking information from booking systems using PNR data and makes it available within operational workflows—without modifying core DCS functionality or increasing manual effort.

challengekeyPoints: Core DCS does not store passenger contact information
A single PNR may include multiple passengers
Passenger details are required close to departure time
Repeated booking system queries could impact system performance

solutionContent.solutionContent: The Guest Bridge layer was designed as a lightweight and efficient middleware solution

solutionKeyPoints: Integration layer operating alongside the existing DCS
Automated data retrieval through scheduled background jobs
Filtering and de-duplication logic to minimize unnecessary booking system calls
Controlled and secure APIs to expose passenger contact details to authorized workflows
Seamless integration without changes to core DCS logic
missionKeyPoints: Ensure passenger contact details are available accurately and on time
Enable this access without impacting core DCS functionality or workflows
goalKeyPoints: Fetch passenger mobile numbers and booking details using PNR information
Support operational and communication needs by enabling passenger contact
Eliminate manual lookups across booking systems
Maintain a single, reliable, and consistent source of passenger information
impactKeyPoints: Passenger mobile numbers available when required for operations
Reduced manual effort and communication delays
Avoided duplicate and unnecessary booking system calls
Enabled smooth and timely passenger communication workflows
Improved data accuracy and consistency within DCS operations

collaboration.collaboration: The application was developed in close collaboration with operations teams and system owners to ensure seamless integration with existing DCS workflows. Data flow, synchronization timing, and usage patterns were carefully aligned with real operational processes, while a strong focus on reliability ensured minimal impact on overall system performance.

conclusion.conclusion: The DCS Guest Bridge Application successfully addressed a critical data gap without disrupting existing systems. By introducing a dedicated middleware layer, the solution enabled timely access to passenger contact information, improved operational communication, and ensured data consistency—demonstrating a scalable and non-intrusive approach to system integration in airline operations.

nodes.name: Pentafox Centralizes Flight Operations Management with the RedCap Platform

Standardized reports for operational monitoring and compliance

Ensure timely and accurate information for ground teams, operations staff, and management
Improve operational awareness and decision-making through structured data, reports, and automated WhatsApp notifications

Reduce communication delays through automated WhatsApp alerts
Maintain accurate, consistent, and audit-ready flight logs and delay records
Support management decision-making with daily and monthly operational reports
impactKeyPoints: Fully centralized and digital flight operation records
Reduced manual effort and data entry errors
Faster and more reliable communication through WhatsApp alerts
Improved visibility into delays and ground performance
Accurate, audit-ready reports for management and regulatory compliance
Enhanced coordination across airline operational teams

collaboration.collaboration: The RedCap system was developed in close collaboration with ground staff, operations teams, and management. Real operational workflows influenced data capture screens, notification logic, and reporting structures. Continuous feedback and iteration ensured the platform aligned with day-to-day airline operational needs.

conclusion.conclusion: RedCap successfully transformed fragmented and manual flight operation tracking into a unified digital system. By centralizing data, automating communication, and enabling real-time visibility, the platform improved operational efficiency, accuracy, and coordination—supporting better decision-making and compliance across airline operations.

nodes.name: Pentafox Digitizes End-to-End Procurement Workflows with the Procure360 Platform

overview.overview: See how Pentafox replaced fragmented email and spreadsheet procurement with a centralized platform that simplifies purchase requests, approvals, and process control.

detailedDescription.detailedDescription:
Earlier, procurement activities such as purchase requests, approvals, and purchase order creation were managed through emails, Excel sheets, and manual follow-ups. Approval status was often unclear, vendor quotations were handled offline, and maintaining an audit trail for compliance was difficult and time-consuming.

Procure360 was developed to digitize the complete procurement lifecycle. The platform manages everything from raising Purchase Requests (PRs) to approving Purchase Orders (POs) and collecting vendor quotations—bringing all procurement activities into a single, centralized, and controlled system.

challengekeyPoints: Approval processes dependent on emails and manual follow-ups
Complex approval logic across departments and item categories
Vendor quotations collected and compared offline
Lack of visibility and traceability for approval actions and timelines

solutionKeyPoints: Role-based workflows for Requesters, Approvers, PO Creators, Vendors, and Admins
Dynamic approval routing using item-level approval matrices
Digital PO uploads and vendor quotation submissions via secure links
Automatic audit logging of every action and status change
Central dashboards to track PR and PO progress in real time
missionKeyPoints: Provide a clear, structured, and standardized procurement workflow
Ensure proper approvals and transparent vendor comparison
Maintain a complete, traceable, and audit-ready procurement history
goalKeyPoints: Streamline the creation, submission, and tracking of Purchase Requests
Enforce approval rules based on department, item category, and quantity
Simplify vendor quotation collection and comparison through secure digital links
Support audits and compliance through end-to-end activity tracking
impactKeyPoints: Fully digitized Purchase Request and Purchase Order processes
Automated approval routing based on predefined business rules
Simple and transparent vendor quotation comparison
Reduced manual follow-ups and approval delays
Complete audit trail supporting compliance and governance
Clear, real-time visibility of PR and PO status across teams

collaboration.collaboration: The platform was developed in close collaboration with procurement teams, finance departments, department heads, and system administrators to ensure it reflected real organizational workflows. Existing processes were carefully analyzed and converted into structured digital flows, while continuous feedback helped refine approval hierarchies, vendor comparison views, and reporting features.

conclusion.conclusion: Procure360 successfully transformed manual and fragmented procurement operations into a transparent, efficient, and audit-ready digital system. By automating approvals, centralizing vendor interactions, and maintaining complete traceability, the platform improved control, compliance, and efficiency across the procurement lifecycle.

nodes.name: WhatsApp Meal Booking System — Meal Booking via WhatsApp Bot

overview.overview:
See how Pentafox improved airline operational communication
without modifying core DCS systems.

detailedDescription.detailedDescription:
Many airline passengers forget to book meals at the time of ticket purchase. Once the booking is completed, adding a meal often requires visiting a website or contacting customer support, which can be inconvenient and time-consuming.
The WhatsApp Meal Booking System was introduced to simplify post-booking meal selection. The system allows airlines to send automated WhatsApp messages to passengers before departure, enabling them to book meals directly through a familiar and widely used platform. Passengers can either interact with a WhatsApp bot for guided booking or use a simple web link, making the process fast, intuitive, and accessible.

challengekeyPoints: Passengers may delay or ignore WhatsApp notifications
Occasional WhatsApp message delivery failures
Payment success with potential booking confirmation issues
Ensuring the booking flow remains simple and easy to understand
Providing support teams with clear visibility into all bookings

solutionContent.solutionContent: The WhatsApp Meal Booking System introduced an automated and passenger-friendly booking approach

solutionKeyPoints: Automated WhatsApp messages sent before flight departure
Guided meal selection through a WhatsApp bot with step-by-step interaction
Quick and easy browser-based booking via a direct web link
Reminder messages sent when passengers choose to book later
Automatic retries for failed WhatsApp message deliveries
Instant confirmation of booking and payment
Alerts to support teams in case of post-payment issues
missionKeyPoints: Enable convenient meal booking through WhatsApp
Eliminate the need for app downloads or customer support interactions
Ensure a smooth, reliable, and user-friendly booking experience
goalKeyPoints: Allow passengers to book meals after ticket purchase
Use WhatsApp as the primary communication and booking channel
Provide flexible booking options through bot chat or a simple web link
Reduce dependency on customer support teams
Enable secure and quick payment processing
Enhance the overall passenger experience
impactKeyPoints: Easy and convenient meal booking through WhatsApp
Increased flexibility with two booking options
Higher add-on meal sales
Reduced customer support workload
Secure and seamless payment experience
Clear and centralized visibility of meal bookings for admin teams

collaboration.collaboration: The system was designed in collaboration with airline business teams, customer support staff, and developers. Insights into real passenger behavior influenced message timing, reminder strategies, and booking flow design. Continuous feedback ensured the platform remained simple, reliable, and passenger-focused.

conclusion.conclusion: The WhatsApp Meal Booking System successfully simplified post-ticket meal booking by leveraging a familiar messaging platform. By combining automation, flexible booking options, and secure payments, the system improved passenger convenience, increased ancillary revenue, and reduced operational overhead—demonstrating the effectiveness of conversational commerce in airline operations.

nodes.name: Pentafox Digitizes Ground Operations Asset Management with the AMS Platform for Airline Operations

nodes.name: Pentafox Digitizes In-Flight Sales and Operations with the IFS Platform

overview.overview:
See how Pentafox digitized boarding and reconciliation
to reduce delays and eliminate errors.

detailedDescription.detailedDescription:
Airlines traditionally relied on manual, paper-based processes to record in-flight sales and inventory details. Cabin crew documented transactions during flights, which often resulted in data entry errors, missing stock, and payment mismatches—especially when flights had multiple legs and limited internet connectivity.
The In-Flight Service (IFS) platform was developed to digitize in-flight sales and operational tracking. It is a web and mobile solution that enables cabin crew to record sales and inventory using mobile devices, while office and management teams monitor sales, stock levels, and payments through a centralized system. All data is securely stored and synchronized to ensure accuracy and transparency.

challengekeyPoints: Unreliable or unavailable internet connectivity during flights
Multiple flight legs within a single journey
Card payment failures during in-flight transactions
Accurate tracking of unsold inventory
Different access requirements for cabin crew, administrators, and management

solutionContent.solutionContent: IFS introduced an offline-first digital platform designed specifically for airline operations

solutionKeyPoints: Offline-capable mobile application with data synchronization at journey start and end
Modular system architecture covering Sales, Inventory, and Reporting
Automated stock updates and handling of payment failures
Role-based access control for cabin crew, admins, and management
Centralized dashboard for real-time monitoring and reporting
missionKeyPoints: Simplify and digitize in-flight sales operations
Ensure reliable sales recording even without internet connectivity
Provide a seamless and efficient sales experience for cabin crew and management
goalKeyPoints: Replace paper-based sales and inventory records with digital entries
Accurately track product sales and stock movement
Minimize payment and inventory discrepancies
Support offline functionality during flights
Provide clear, actionable reports for operational and management teams
impactKeyPoints: Complete elimination of manual paperwork
Accurate and reliable tracking of in-flight sales and inventory
Significant reduction in payment and stock discrepancies
Faster workflows and smoother operational processes
Clear, data-driven reports for management decision-making

collaboration.collaboration: IFS was developed in close partnership with cabin crew and administrative teams. Real-world flight feedback shaped usability, offline workflows, and reporting features. Iterative improvements ensured the platform aligned with operational realities and business needs.

conclusion.conclusion: In-Flight Service (IFS) platform transformed in-flight sales and operations from a manual, error-prone process into a streamlined digital system. By enabling offline functionality, automating inventory and payment handling, and providing centralized visibility, IFS enhanced efficiency, accuracy, and overall control—delivering measurable improvements for airline operations.

nodes.name: Pentafox Streamlines Crew Cab Booking and Journey Management with the Enroute Platform

Enroute was introduced to centralize and automate crew cab booking and journey management.

conclusion.conclusion: Enroute transformed manual and fragmented crew cab coordination into a centralized, automated system. By digitizing bookings, automating communication, and providing real-time visibility, the platform improved efficiency, reduced errors, and ensured reliable crew transportation across airline operations.

nodes.name: Pentafox Digitizes Passenger Boarding and Reconciliation with the PRS Platform

nodes.name: Pentafox Automates Competitive Fare Analysis and Pricing Decisions with the Pricing Portal Platform

nodes.name: Pentafox Centralizes Airline Flight Operations Monitoring with the CoreOps Platform

nodes.name: Pentafox Digitizes Alcohol Testing Compliance with the Breathalyzer Platform for Aviation Operations

detailedDescription.detailedDescription:
KVB-LMS (Lead Management System) is a web and tablet-based application developed for the banking sector to streamline the management of customer (leads). In banks, a lead refers to a potential customer who has shown interest in purchasing a loan.

Before the implementation of KVB-LMS, banking staff relied on manual processes and fragmented systems to record, track, and follow up on Customers (leads). This approach often resulted in inconsistent data, delayed follow-ups, difficulty in tracking lead status, and reduced conversion efficiency.

To address these challenges, KVB-LMS was designed as a centralized digital platform that allows bank employees to capture, update, and manage lead information efficiently through both web and tablet applications. The system enables staff to maintain complete customer details, monitor lead progress, and ensure timely follow-ups, thereby improving operational efficiency and customer experience.

The project focuses on providing a secure, user-friendly, and reliable solution that supports banking staff in managing high volumes of leads while maintaining data accuracy and compliance with banking standards.

Real-Time Lead Updates -- Handling frequent changes in lead status and ensuring real-time visibility for banking staff working from different locations.
Security & Compliance -- Ensuring secure access to the application and protecting sensitive customer data in compliance with banking standards while maintaining ease of use.
Tablet Performance & Network Issues -- Supporting smooth performance and usability on tablet devices used for field operations, including handling network fluctuations.
Multi-Platform Testing & Validation -- Coordinating testing and validation across multiple platforms and workflows to ensure reliable end-to-end lead management.
